items.headline: Jackson Koivun's Resilience
items.text: Jackson Koivun, fresh off winning the 3M Open by beating Scottie Scheffler, showed strong resilience at the Rocket Classic by making the cut with a Friday 67 after opening 69, demonstrating his ability to grind when not at his best.

items.headline: Davis Riley Leads Rocket Classic
items.text: Davis Riley overcame a difficult 2026 slump, citing wayward driving as his Achilles heel, and gained a one-shot 54-hole lead at the Rocket Classic after a bogey-free 63, motivated by his pregnant wife and improved driving and putting.
